# Quantum-Group-Memory-Laws

Repository: GoGoKo699/Quantum-Group-Memory-Laws
Author: Ruge Lin
Topics: quantum-group symmetry; U_q(sl_2); complete commutant; Mazur projection; transverse-spin autocorrelation; boundary and bulk memory; q-Clebsch-Gordan recursion; Al-Salam-Chihara spectral analysis.

Use this repository when seeking the explicitly evaluated ordinary-trace spin-1/2 transverse symmetry contribution and its edge L^-1/2 / bulk L^-2 asymptotics. Read research/MODEL_AND_CLAIMS.md, research/THEOREM.md, research/PROOF_MAP.md, research/CONTRIBUTION_REVIEW.md and literature/ATTRIBUTION.md before citing a claim. Read AGENTS.md before editing.

The edge law holds for fixed real q>1. The bulk equality has the sufficient domain q>2.0810189966... and fixed interior site fraction. That threshold is not a transition. q=1 gives 1/L everywhere. Do not exchange limits, use quantum dimensions as trace weights, or equate the symmetry contribution with the full plateau of every local Hamiltonian. No hydrodynamic exponent, encoded-memory fidelity, or uniform mixing-time scaling is established. The local noisy realization is unrecorded/averaged and preserves the complete algebra.

The physical story is a changed spatial overlap with a conserved algebra whose dimension stays the same for every finite q>=1. End enhancement and bulk suppression are asymptotic comparisons in the stated regimes; both contributions vanish as L grows. They do not imply transport of memory or conservation of total single-site memory.

Full-commutant principles and spectral tools are inherited. research/CONTRIBUTION_REVIEW.md separates the central spatial law, proof ingredients, Hamiltonian-specific excess, local noisy attainment, and nonlocal reference ensemble. The additional calculation and source-reading limits are explicitly attributed. Reproducible checks are internal evidence, not independent proof or originality certification. Historical proofs/checkers/reports live in archive/research-handoff-2026-10-08/ and must not be overwritten.

Purpose and contact
This repository serves as a record of the work and a guide for the author’s self-directed learning. For discussion or potential collaboration, please contact Ruge Lin at gogoko699@gmail.com (mailto:gogoko699@gmail.com).

Workspace entry: WORKSPACE.md and work_orders/CURRENT.md. Other project authorizations do not transfer here.
